requirements: R1: The Falsification Audit report generation logic must not cite invalid pattern IDs like DEVID_VELLEMAN_09_CONVERSATION_MAXIM that do not exist in the role charters, and must return informative output.

slices.title: Fix hallucinated pattern IDs in methodological violations
slices.jtbd: When implementing the falsification audit generator for this epic, I want the output to cross-check cited philosophical pattern IDs against the provided charters, so that methodological violations correctly reference valid patterns and reject hallucinations.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a generated falsification report citing a pattern ID
When the system evaluates the response
Then it verifies the ID exists in the role context and replaces hallucinated ones with valid observations.
slices.definitionOfDone: Logic does not output missing pattern IDs. Output falls back safely or returns a clear error instead of generating unknown IDs.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: hallucinated methodological pattern citations reduced to 0
